description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'scalar' command, including setup, execution of various tests, and checking command behaviors and outputs within a Git-related project.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a specific command sequence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks for expected exit code when running a command.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the main test, for cleanup.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies whether a specific file or directory is missing.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Verifies whether a specific path is a directory.

methods.name: test_subcommand
methods.description: Checks the successful execution of a subcommand, usually related to Git.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Confirms that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file is not empty.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in a file and compares with expected.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates commits in a repository for testing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern matches in output or files.
